messages.author: 409dfe1554e9c224
messages.subject: geom_density and size by group
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to achieve a geom_density plot in which the size (line width) corresponds to the number of observations in the group represented.
Based on the help for stat_density, I am trying

> library(ggplot2)
> library(plyr) # to access round_any
> movies$decade <- round_any(movies$year, 10)
> m <- ggplot(movies, aes(x=rating, colour=decade, group=decade))
> m + geom_density(aes(fill=NA,size=..count..)

But this fails with
> Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
>  Aesthetics can not vary with a ribbon

Can anyone point out where I err and how to remedy?

Sincerely, Joh

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: geom_density and size by group
parts:
The error message tells exactly what the problem is--you can't vary an
aesthetic (here line width) over a line; for the same reason, a line
can't change color as it goes. You'll need to find another way to plot
this information.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: geom_density and size by group
parts:
On Tue, Jan 29, 2013 at 7:20 AM, Ben Bond-Lamberty <bpb...@gmail.com> wrote:
> The error message tells exactly what the problem is--you can't vary an
> aesthetic (here line width) over a line; for the same reason, a line
> can't change color as it goes. You'll need to find another way to plot
> this information.
That's not what the error says, nor is it true:

m <- ggplot(movies, aes(x=rating))
m + stat_density(aes(color = ..count..), geom="line")

The error says aesthetics can't vary within a ribbon, but there is no
reason the density has to be plotted with a ribbon goem.

Best,
Ista
